en_title: The Legend of Zelda Series Was in 'Dire Straits' Before Breath of the Wild, Former Nintendo Marketing Leads Say
cn_title: 任天堂前营销负责人称，《塞尔达传说》系列在《旷野之息》推出前曾「陷入困境」
opus_summary: 任天堂前营销负责人Kit Ellis和Krysta Yang称，《旷野之息》推出前，《塞尔达传说》系列销量低迷，玩家群体不断萎缩，也未能吸引新玩家。他们认为，《旷野之息》的新玩法拯救了系列，而非毁掉它。该作在Switch上售出3428万份，续作《王国之泪》迄今售出2290万份。

paragraphs.en: The Zelda series was in “dire straits” before Breath of the Wild, with a dwindling playerbase and low sales, according to former Nintendo marketing leads.
paragraphs.cn: 据任天堂前营销负责人称，《塞尔达传说》系列在《旷野之息》推出前曾「陷入困境」，玩家群体不断萎缩，销量也很低。

paragraphs.en: Kit Ellis and Krysta Yang, who both worked at Nintendo for over a decade, made the claims on the latest episode of their podcast (as spotted by GamesRadar+ ). They refuted the idea that Breath of the Wild ruined the Zelda series with its new formula, and instead argued that it actually saved the franchise from a loss of relevance.
paragraphs.cn: Kit Ellis和Krysta Yang都曾在任天堂工作十余年，他们在最新一期播客节目中作出了上述表示（由GamesRadar+发现）。他们驳斥了《旷野之息》以新模式毁掉《塞尔达传说》系列的说法，认为它实际上拯救了这个逐渐失去影响力的系列。

paragraphs.en: It comes as part of a discussion about “new Zelda” versus “old Zelda” — or essentially, the dungeon format versus a complete open world. While there is clearly a demand for the older Zelda games, as evidenced by the hugely successful Ocarina of Time remake, the pair say there is a good reason why Nintendo took them away from us in the first place.
paragraphs.cn: 这是他们关于「新塞尔达」与「旧塞尔达」之争的讨论的一部分——本质上也就是迷宫形式与完整开放世界之争。虽然玩家显然对老式《塞尔达传说》游戏有需求，大获成功的《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版便证明了这一点，但两人表示，任天堂当初将它们从我们身边拿走是有充分理由的。

paragraphs.en: “There has been some revisionist history out there lately, about how the Zelda team ripped these away from us at the peak of their popularity,” Ellis says. Yang then expresses her disbelief that fans think this way. “That’s ridiculous. This series was in dire straits. They were selling, like, nothing.” Ellis goes into more detail: “I remember, I was going to the focus groups, and it was a really dark moment when the feedback [was that] the fanbase is dwindling, this is not bringing in new players.” Yang agrees again, saying that it was “depressing,” and that the playerbase was shrinking “smaller and smaller” with each new Zelda release.
paragraphs.cn: Ellis说：「最近有一些篡改历史的说法，称《塞尔达传说》团队在这些游戏最受欢迎的时候把它们从我们身边夺走了。」随后，Yang对粉丝们这么想表示难以置信。「这太荒谬了。这个系列当时陷入了困境。它们的销量几乎为零。」Ellis进一步解释道：「我记得我当时参加了焦点小组，收到的反馈是粉丝群体正在萎缩，游戏没有吸引到新玩家，那真是一段黑暗的时期。」Yang再次表示赞同，称这「令人沮丧」，而且每推出一款新的《塞尔达传说》游戏，玩家群体都会变得「越来越小」。

paragraphs.en: Before Breath of the Wild came out in 2017, the Zelda series had seen Wii entry Skyward Sword in 2011, A Link Between Worlds in 2013, and various HD and 3D re-releases. Certainly, Breath of the Wild was an enormous hit, selling an incredible 34.28 million copes on the Switch. Its sequel, Tears of the Kingdom, came out in 2023 and has sold 22.90 million so far.
paragraphs.cn: 在《旷野之息》于2017年推出之前，《塞尔达传说》系列曾于2011年推出Wii作品《Skyward Sword》，于2013年推出《A Link Between Worlds》，还有多款高清和3D再版作品。当然，《旷野之息》取得了巨大成功，在Switch上售出了惊人的3428万份。其续作《王国之泪》于2023年推出，迄今已售出2290万份。

paragraphs.en: The Ocarina of Time remake looks like it continues the positive sales trend , becoming the fastest-selling Switch 2 game so far. The question now is, what will Nintendo do with its inevitable next mainline Zelda game?
paragraphs.cn: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版似乎延续了良好的销售势头，成为迄今为止销售速度最快的Switch 2游戏。现在的问题是，任天堂将如何处理必然会推出的下一款《塞尔达传说》系列正传游戏？
